name: Volume Rendering Prior (VRPrior)
definition:
A neural network $f_w$ that maps unsigned distances and sampling intervals of neighboring points to opaque density $
$, replacing handcrafted equations to provide 3D awareness and robustness to unsigned distance outliers.
summary: VRPrior replaces handcrafted density mappings with a learnable neural network that incorporates 3D context from neighboring points to solve bias and outlier sensitivity in volume rendering.
